// Fixture for scripts/__tests__/validate-ws-actions.test.mjs — the wrapper
// vocabulary covering every runner action in sdk_client.rs, plus one orphan.
export const handlers = {
  plain: () => relayCommand('plainAction'),
  typed: () => relay.queueCommand<unknown>('typedAction', {}),
  byId: () => relayWithFallback('byIdAction', {}),
  crateVisible: () => relayCommand('crateVisibleAction'),
  publicAction: () => relayCommand('publicAction'),
  longDoc: () => relayCommand('longDocAction'),
  legacy: () => relayCommand('legacyAction'),
  undocumented: () => relayCommand('undocumentedAction'),
  orphan: () => relayCommand('wrapperOnlyAction'),
};
